# Support boundary project

This project demonstrates supported and runtime-dependent Eve filesystem surfaces.

asset.content:
# Eve runtime boundary

Canonical static relationships use the Eve `0.39.x` TypeScript filesystem forms proven by local inspection: a flat or nested `agent.ts`; one exclusive lowercase `instructions.md` or supported TypeScript instructions module at the agent root; recursive TypeScript `defineTool` modules; TypeScript `defineSkill` modules; direct schema bindings; and registered, directory-backed local subagents with canonical routing descriptions.

Preserved dynamic tools, flat or packaged Markdown skills, single-file subagents, and case-varied, legacy, or composed instruction examples are not canonical without focused runtime wiring and tests. Prefer the corresponding supported static form when runtime evidence is unavailable.

Remote agents, extension contributions, connection and framework tools, filesystem collisions, reserved names, and advanced runtime behavior likewise require source-owned runtime evidence or a supported, collision-free static filesystem form. Static discovery alone does not prove provider, model, routing, registration, or execution behavior.
